- Put your whole iPhone screen on the car display: works with any app, even ones without a Cast button
- Open any app and it shows up on the car screen exactly as on your phone

WHAT IT DOES
All you need is an M3U or M3U8 link. CarTV parses it, sorts the entries into the groups defined in your playlist, and plays them. No account, no sign-in, nothing to configure.

FORMATS AND PLAYBACK
- M3U and M3U8 playlists
- HLS and standard HTTP streams
- Hardware-accelerated decoding, with a software decoder as fallback for MKV, HEVC and DTS
- Embedded and external subtitles, including tracks extracted from MKV
- Reads tvg-logo and group-title tags from your playlist
- Remembers where you left off

YOUR OWN MEDIA SERVER
- Connect to your own Jellyfin or Emby server
- Browse your libraries, seasons and episodes
- Episodes are sorted automatically and resume where you stopped
- Server addresses and credentials never leave your device

CAR MODE
A landscape layout made for a phone in a dashboard mount: oversized controls, large type, and one-tap switching between entries. Built for passengers.
Note: for passenger use only. Never watch while driving.

MOMENTS WORTH STOPPING FOR
Park by the lake on a quiet weekend, set up your fishing rod, and finally watch that old movie you've been saving. At the campsite, stay curled up with your partner after sunset while you wait for the stars. During a forty-minute charging stop, watch two cartoons with the kids or catch up on that movie you and your friends have talked about for ages. When the car is parked and the big display lights up, an ordinary wait becomes time worth remembering.

MANAGE YOUR PLAYLISTS
- Add as many playlist URLs as you need, by link or by scanning a QR code
- Refresh, rename, or remove any of them
- Filter by the groups in your playlist
- Mark favourites for quick access
- Import video files from your device and play them offline

MINI PLAYER
Keep playing while you browse the rest of your list. No need to back out and start over.

PRIVACY
Everything you add stays on your iPhone. No account needed.

CarTV is a player only. It does not provide, host, bundle, or recommend any content. You supply your own playlists and servers and are responsible for having the right to use them.

apps.releaseNotes:
This update unblocks several situations where the app became unusable, and adds live rewind, a full programme guide, and much richer film pages.

WITHOUT A CONNECTION

• The app no longer hangs at startup when there is no network. It says so plainly instead of reporting an authentication error.
• Your downloads stay reachable from that screen: they are the content that genuinely works offline.
• Losing the network while using the app leads there too.
• As soon as the network returns, the app picks up on its own.

DOWNLOADS

• An interrupted download — locked screen, lost network, app closed — resumes where it stopped instead of starting over.
• It no longer vanishes from your list: it stays visible, with a button to restart it.
• Resuming is now automatic after a drop, with nothing to go back to.
• Progress no longer falls back to zero after a failure, and an incomplete file can no longer be played by mistake.

LIVE TV

• New: rewind live television from 30 seconds up to 30 minutes on the channels your provider archives. The bar appears only on those.
• A navigation bar at the bottom of the player lets you aim at a precise moment, and return to live with one gesture.

PROGRAMME GUIDE

• New: a guide reachable from the header and from the Live page. Each channel shows what is on now, how far along it is, and what follows.
• It opens on your favorites, and search finds a programme by its title, not only a channel by its name.
• Selecting a channel opens its full schedule, live and catch-up alike.
• It now works with M3U sources and not only compatible portals: its address is read from the playlist itself.

MOVIES AND SERIES

• Film pages now show the title logo, a backdrop, the cast with the characters they play, and a synopsis in your language.
• Playback starts straight away when a version in your language exists, instead of asking every time.
• The wait before playback is markedly shorter on films with several versions.
• A versions button shows how many exist and lets you pick another, 4K included.
• New setting: prefer the lighter version. Useful on slow connections.

TITLES AND TEXT

• Titles and categories in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Cyrillic and Arabic no longer appear as unreadable characters, whatever the source.
• Titles written in a non-Latin alphabet are back in the home selections, where they were missing.
• Resuming a film no longer restarts at another title's position.
• French titles carrying a single accent now display correctly.

DISPLAY AND NAVIGATION

• On iPhone, navigation stays in portrait while the player rotates freely — the interface is no longer stretched when the device is lying down.
• The sign-in page scrolls, and its content no longer slides under the notch.
• A live channel no longer appears by mistake in Continue Watching.
• Opening a series no longer throws an error screen when its page is incomplete.
• A decoding hiccup on a live channel no longer covers a picture that is still playing with a full-screen error.

ACCOUNT

• New: connect another device to your account by entering a short code from a device already signed in. No password to retype.
• Deleting an account now warns that it does not cancel your App Store subscription, and offers a direct way to manage it.
• A subscription can no longer be bought without an account, which would have attached it to nothing. The screen offers to sign in, then resumes the purchase.
• Adding a source: the library no longer shows up empty on first launch.

apps.name: Xtream Ahoy! IPTV
apps.description:
Xtream Ahoy! allows you to browse your playlist of IPTV channels and movies via Xtream codes. Browse the contents of your favorite playlists, discover channels and movies right at your fingertips. Unlock the power to access your favorite live TV channels and movies effortlessly and in style. 

Important Notes: 
- The app does not supply any live channels by its now.
- As of now, Xtream Ahoy! exclusively supports live channels, movies and TV Shows.
- Xtream ahoy! does NOT include any media player for watching your channels.
- Playback will require external apps like VLC (recommended).

Features:

• Super Fast Channel surfing: Xtream Ahoy! lets you effortlessly navigate through your playlists instantly. Say goodbye to endless loading times and scrolling and enjoy quick access to your favorite content.

• Secure Access, Peace of Mind: Your security is our priority. Xtream Ahoy! ensures your personal data remains confidential and secure in the Keychain, allowing you to enjoy seamless streaming without worrying about privacy concerns.

• Multiple Playlist Support: Xtream Ahoy! makes managing multiple playlists a breeze. Effortlessly explore live channels from various sources without complex configurations or technical expertise.

• Watch in VLC Player: Xtream Ahoy! enhances your streaming experience further by enabling you to open live channels directly in the VLC media player. Enjoy a seamless transition from Xtream Ahoy! to VLC and get the best possible experience.

• Deep Link Configuration: Customize your streaming experience with Xtream Ahoy's advanced deep link configuration. Seamlessly integrate your preferred live streaming sources using the deep link: xtream-ahoy://launch?url=YOUR_URL&username=YOUR_USERNAME&password=YOUR_PASSWORD.

• Automatic playlist creation: simply copy your m3u string from your IPTV provider and Stream Ahoy will create a new playlist for you.

Disclaimer:

Xtream Ahoy! is a content discovery app that provides users with a user-friendly interface to access live channel playlists via Xtream codes. The app does not own, host, or provide any content of its own. It relies on the user's playlists to fetch and display live channels based on user-provided information.

Users are solely responsible for the content they choose to access or add to the app. Xtream Ahoy! does not endorse, control, or monitor the content made available through the app. The app's developer assumes that users will make fair and lawful use of the app and its features.

Please be aware that the app's functionality is designed to help users browse their preferred live channel playlists. Any content added, accessed, or shared by users is their own responsibility. If you have concerns about the content, legality, or ownership of the channels you access, we recommend verifying the sources and adhering to copyright and licensing laws.

By using Xtream Ahoy!, you agree that the app and its developer are not liable for the content added by users or the consequences of its use. It is important to use the app in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

apps.name: Xtream IPTV Click PlayList M3U
apps.description:
Watch any live channel, movie, or series directly on your iPhone and iPad. Stream Click supports M3U playlists and Xtream Codes with full EPG program guide, TV catchup, multi-screen viewing, and offline downloads — all in one clean, fast app.

--- LIVE TV ---
Connect with your M3U or Xtream Codes subscription and access thousands of live channels instantly. Navigate categories, use the built-in EPG guide to see what is on right now, and rewind broadcasts with TV catchup.

--- MOVIES AND SERIES ---
Browse your full VOD library with movie details, season and episode navigation, and autoplay for the next episode. Download content to watch offline anytime.

--- MULTI-SCREEN ---
Watch up to 4 channels at the same time on one screen. Perfect for sports events, news, and entertainment — no more choosing between your favorites.

--- POWERFUL PLAYER ---
Built on VLC for maximum format compatibility: HLS, MPEG-TS, RTMP, MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, and more. Switch audio tracks, subtitle tracks, and video crop on the fly. AirPlay and Picture-in-Picture supported.

--- ORGANIZATION AND CONTROL ---
- Favorites for Live TV, Movies, and Series
- Recently watched history with configurable limit
- Hide categories you do not need
- Parental control with PIN and biometric lock
- Auto-update your playlist on a schedule
- Multiple playlists and multiple user profiles
- QR code scanner to share and import playlists

--- FORMATS SUPPORTED ---
M3U, M3U Plus, M3U8, XSPF, HLS, MPEG-TS, RTMP, MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, FLV, TS, WebM, and more.

--- LANGUAGES ---
Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Indonesian.

apps.name: YES IPTV Player
apps.description:
YES IPTV Player elevates your IPTV experience with powerful features, a modern and user-friendly interface.
Easily watch movies, series, and live streams with unlimited playlist support for Xtream API and M3U. Download your content and enjoy it offline without an internet connection.

YES IPTV PLAYER DOES NOT PROVIDE ANY CONTENT.
You can get the best experience by adding your own content.

YES IPTV Player is designed as an alternative to popular IPTV apps such as IPTVX, Opus, Chillio, UHF, TiviMate, Tivimax, Snappier, IPTV+ and Smarters. It offers a Netflix-style, clean user experience without ads, watermarks, or complex navigation. The app focuses only on the user’s playlist and never shows unavailable content. It provides one of the most feature-rich free experiences while keeping premium features more affordable.

KEY FEATURES

- YES IPTV is now on Apple TV!

- Download & Offline Watching
Download content and watch without an internet connection.

- Unlimited Playlist Support
Add and manage unlimited playlists in Xtream API and M3U formats.

- Category Personalization & Parental Lock
Sort, hide, or lock categories with a password. Shape your viewing experience.

- Fast Channel Switching in Live TV
Switch channels from the player without stopping the stream.

- Catchup TV Support
Watch previously aired content if supported by your IPTV provider.

- PiP Support
Keep watching your content while navigating between apps (only with KSPlayer).

- TMDB Integration
Rich experience with detailed info on movies and series, including season and episode support.

- Advanced Search
Quickly search among movies, series, and live TV content.

- Homepage Features
Stay up to date with dynamic sections like Continue Watching, Newly Added, Recommended, and Recently Watched Channels.

- Favorites & Watch History
Save your favorite content and track your viewing history.

- Trakt Integration
Sync your watch history with your Trakt account.

- Auto Episode/Season Switching
Automatically jump to the next episode or season while watching series (if available).

- EPG Support & Program Reminders
View live broadcast schedules from your IPTV provider or custom EPG URL and set reminders for upcoming programs.

- Best-in-Class VoiceOver Support
Improved accessibility with full VoiceOver integration for visually impaired users.

- Spotlight Search Support
Quickly find and access movies, series, live TV, and favorite content from your device’s search screen.

- Playback, Subtitle & Audio Controls
Adjust subtitles, audio tracks, sync, playback speed, aspect ratio, default preferences.

- OpenSubtitles Integration
Search and download online subtitles for your content.

- Auto Playlist Refresh
Playlists are refreshed automatically when the app launches or at intervals you choose (between Off and every 7 days).

- Family Sharing Support
Share your subscription with your family using Apple Family Sharing.

- iCloud Sync
Sync favorites, watch history, and settings across all your devices.

- Background Playback
Continue watching even when the screen is off or when using other apps.

- Theme Options
Choose from light, dark, or system default theme.

NOTICES

- YES IPTV Player has no affiliation with any third-party content provider.

- YES IPTV Player does not provide any content. You must supply your own playlist to use the app. We do not support the unauthorized use of copyrighted content.

- YES IPTV Player uses the VLCKit player, maintained by the VLC developers.

- YES IPTV Player uses the TMDb API to provide information about your content, but is not endorsed or certified by TMDb.

- The screenshots shown on this page are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent real video content. YES IPTV Player and its developer do not provide or take responsibility for any digital content. You must supply your own digital media and have an active iCloud account to use this app.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
